description: This file defines a custom React hook `useProviderFields` that fetches provider creation metadata using react-query. It imports external modules and functions related to networking, query management, and query key generation, and sets up the hook to retrieve data with caching strategies.

methods.name: useProviderFields
methods.description: A React hook that performs a data fetch for provider creation information, leveraging caching and reactivity features from react-query library.
